broad_single.instructions: This call is a missed booking: the caller wanted an appointment but did not end up with one, and did not give up on it themselves.

wanted_to_book.instructions: During this call the caller expressed a wish to schedule, reschedule or get a visit or appointment, even if only implied by describing a problem they need someone to come and fix.

criteria.true: The caller asks for, or clearly needs and seeks, a visit or appointment for themselves or someone else.
criteria.false: The caller only asks about prices, hours or a past appointment, wants to cancel, reached the wrong number, is spam, or never speaks.

booking_confirmed.instructions: By the end of the call the agent has confirmed an appointment with a specific date and a specific time, and it was not cancelled later in the call.

criteria.true: The agent states or reaffirms a specific day and clock time (or time window) as booked, including a moved appointment or a booking for the wrong service.
criteria.false: No time was confirmed: only pencilled in, a note taken, a waitlist, a callback promised, a date without a time, a transfer, a dropped call, or the booking was cancelled afterwards.

caller_withdrew.instructions: The caller wanted an appointment but then chose on their own to drop it.

criteria.true: The caller says they will call back later, changed their mind, find it too expensive, will go elsewhere, or cancels the booking they just made.
criteria.false: The caller never gave up on it: the agent, the system or the call itself failed them, or they got their appointment, or they never wanted one.

agent_failed_or_deferred.instructions: The agent could not complete scheduling during this call and deferred it.

criteria.true: System error, promised callback, message taken, waitlist, transfer to a person, or the call ended before a time was agreed.
criteria.false: The agent either completed a booking or the caller did not need one.

call_cut_short.instructions: The call ended abruptly before the conversation reached a natural end (dropped call or hang-up mid-way).
